# Unit test for function histogram
def test_histogram():
    # Test empty string
    assert histogram("") == {}, "Empty string should return empty dict"

    # Test single word
    assert histogram("a") == {"a": 1}, "Single word should return dict with count 1"

    # Test all words tied at count 1
    assert histogram("a b c") == {"a": 1, "b": 1, "c": 1}, "All tied words should appear"

    # Test tied maximum greater than 1
    assert histogram("a b b a") == {"a": 2, "b": 2}, "Tied maximum should include all max words"

    # Test single repeated word
    assert histogram("b b b b") == {"b": 4}, "Repeated word should count all occurrences"

    # Test mixed counts, only maximum returned
    assert histogram("a b c a b") == {"a": 2, "b": 2}, "Only max-count words should be returned"

    # Test extra spaces (empty tokens ignored)
    assert histogram("a  b a") == {"a": 2}, "Empty strings from extra spaces should be ignored"

    # Test words with different lengths
    assert histogram("cat dog cat") == {"cat": 2}, "Unique maximum should be returned"

    print("All tests passed!")


test_histogram()
